{{Quote|Waytha ara quetha way. Waytha ara quetha way!|[[Teneniel Djo]]|<ref name="COPL" />}}
'''Dathomiri''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] used by the culture of [[Witch/Legends|witches]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] known as the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. Specifically, it was utilized alongside [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], by both the [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] members of the order. Historically, it had ties to the [[Paecian/Legends|language]] of Dathomir's [[Paecian Empire]]. The [[Shaman of the Nightsisters|Shaman]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] and the [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sisters]] of her [[Coven/Legends|coven]], the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], often used it during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to perform incantations. Members of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] were known to utilize the [[Language/Legends|language]] frequently. 

==Description==
===Characteristics===
{{Quote|Then you are a male witch, a Jai, from beyond the stars?|Teneniel Djo to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="COPL" />}}
[[File:SingingMountainClan.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Witches of Dathomir were the speakers of Dathomiri.]]
Dathomiri<ref name="GH">{{InsiderCite|142|Good Hunting}}</ref> was a [[Language/Legends|language]] was utilized by the [[Witches of Dathomir]], a culture of [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="COPL" /> and [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]]<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref> [[Witch/Legends|witches]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="COPL" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was similar to and potentially derived from [[Paecian/Legends|Paecian]], the language of the ancient [[Paecian Empire]].<ref name="COPL" />

===Known words===
*'''[[Jai (Dathomir)|Jai]]''' &mdash; '[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]'<ref name="COPL" />
*'''Wooka''' &mdash; '[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]' (the Dathomiri name for the [[Species/Legends|species]])<ref name="COPL" />
*'''Whuffa''' &mdash; '[[Whuffa worm]]' (the Dathomiri name for the species)<ref name="COPL" />

===Known Dathomiri incantations===

As recited by [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]:<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref>
<poem>''Geiss kan erde mak harden ob stein.''
''Geiss kan lewf mak krig ob blitz.''
''Geiss kan pire mak blud loge raga.''
''Geiss kan vass byn skol zum Asajj.''
''Erde-blitz-raga-byn erde-blitz raga byn.''
''Erde-blitz-raga-byn zum'' Asajj.''</poem>

====Chant of Resurrection====
As [[Chant of Resurrection/Legends|recited]] by [[Daka/Legends|Old Daka]]:<ref name="Massacre" />

''Lucheno vadem klavlane.''
''Blenay vedi nalem koreem.''
''Blenay vedi nalem koreem.''
''Villos susko kono lamal!''
''Vlemon tagoo!''</poem>

====Mind restoration spell====
As recited by Mother Talzin:<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>
<poem>''Amenda vla'ben troshana bon'te.''
''Amenda vla'ben troshana bon'te!''</poem>

====Spell of Storm====
As [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Whirlwind|recited]] by [[Teneniel Djo]]:<ref name="COPL" />
<poem>''Waytha ara quetha way.''
''Waytha ara quetha way.''
''Waytha ara quetha way.''
''Waytha ara quetha way!''</poem>

==History==
===Origins===
{{Quote|Their language is not in my catalog. Some terms of their dialogue may be ancient Paecian, but I've never heard the term whuffa.|C-3PO|<ref name="COPL" />}}
[[File:GiantWuffaWorm-FFp22.png|thumb|right|250px|"Whuffa," the Dathomiri word for the whuffa worms (pictured), was perhaps derived from Paecian.]]
Sometime before [[2992 BBY]],<ref name="Paecian-Date">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'' establishes that the [[Paecian Empire]], who had colonized [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], collapsed around 3000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of the novel. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''The Courtship of Princess Leia'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], and thus the Paecian Empire must have collapsed around [[2992 BBY]] and must have colonized Dathomir before that year.</ref> Humans from<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Outer Rim<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> planet [[Paecia/Legends|Paecia]] founded the Paecian Empire.<ref name="TEA" /> The empire colonized Dathomir<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> and imposed its language, Paecian, onto the people of the planet.<ref name="COPL" /> Even after the empire collapsed around 2992 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Paecian-Date" /> the influence of the Paecians remained. The native women of the planet formed the language, Dathomiri, which contained many phrases and words similar to and perhaps derived from those of the Paecian language.<ref name="COPL" /> After the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Allya/Legends|Allya]] was exiled to Dathomir<ref name="TEA" /> in [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> she taught the native women the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and they eventually became the Witches of Dathomir.<ref name="COPL" />

===Use during the Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Ventress will need the aid of the undead army to achieve victory.''"<br />"''Then I will begin the Chant of Ressurection.|Talzin and Daka during the Battle of Dathomir|<ref name="Massacre" />}}
[[File:OldDakaHS-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|During the Battle of Dathomir, Old Daka recited the Chant of Resurrection in Dathomiri.]] 
Prior to and during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of the Witches of Dathomir spoke<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref> and wrote<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> mainly in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], but utilized Dathomiri during incantations and spells. The Nightsister [[Clan mother/Legends|Clan mother]] Talzin used the language in several notable instances.<ref name="Revenge" /><ref name="Monster" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Monster-Date">{{TCWdates|313}}</ref> she spoke an incantation which transformed<ref name="Monster" /> her son<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref><ref name="Son of Dathomir 3">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 3|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 3]]</ref> [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], a member of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] who were [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] subservient to the Nightsisters, into a hulking version of himself.<ref name="Monster" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="FF24">{{FactFile2014|24|MAU 1-2|Darth Maul's Cybernetic Legs}}</ref> she recited an incantation in Dathomiri to restore the mind of <ref name="Revenge" /> another one of her sons,<ref name="Son of Dathomir 3" /> the broken [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]].<ref name="Revenge" /> During the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Separatist invasion of Dathomir]]<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref> in 20 BBY,<ref name="Massacre-Date">{{TCWdates|419}}</ref> the eldest and wisest Nightsister Daka recited the Dathomiri Chant of Ressurection to raise [[Army of the Dead/Legends|dead Nightsisters]] to fight against the invasion force.<ref name="Massacre" />

===Use during the Imperial Period===
[[File:Dathomirilanguage.png|thumb|250px|Charal kneeling before Terak after failing to activate a crystal oscillator using a Dathomiri chant]]
By the time of the Imperial Period, the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] obtained a preference for Basic as well.<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref><ref name="SWGQuest">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=general|Gethzerion|Dathomir}}</ref> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> the Nightsister<ref name="Charal-CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|119|Charal}}</ref> [[Charal]],<ref name="BFE">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> was stranded on<ref name="Illustrated">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> the Outer Rim<ref name="TEA" /> [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. By this time, she had established an alliance with the [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] [[King/Legends|king]] [[Terak]] who was on a [[Battle of Endor (Ewok–Sanyassan conflict)|quest]] to retrieve a [[crystal oscillator]] that was in possession of the [[Towani family]]. After Terak retrieved the oscillator and brought it back to [[Terak's Keep|his]] [[Castle/Legends|castle]], Charal attempted to activate it using a Dathomiri spell to no avail.<ref name="BFE" /> 

===Use during the post-Imperial era===
{{Quote|At this very moment, three sisters have gone to retrieve your ship so that you and your hairy Wooka can fix it.|Augwynne Djo, to Han Solo and Leia Organa|<ref name="COPL" />}}
[[File:TenelKa.png|thumb|left|200px|When she was on the planet Luuhar, Tenel Ka sensed danger and recited a war cry in Dathomiri.]]
By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="COPL-Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] it places in the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|post-Imperial era]].</ref> the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] returned to a more frequent use of Dathomiri.<ref name="COPL" /> In 8 ABY<ref name="COPL-Date" /> during the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|post-Imperial era]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] members [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited Dathomir. They encountered some of members of the Singing Mountain who began exclaiming the word "whuffa." The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] C-3PO,<ref name="COPL" /> who was programmed for language recognition,<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> stated that their dialogue was not one he recognized, but was able to note its connection to Paecian. Throughout the group's stay, they befriended many members of the Singing Mountain Clan, including Teneniel Djo. During the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]] against the Nightsisters, Djo recited the Spell of Storm in Dathomiri.<ref name="COPL" />

Eventually, Teneniel [[Reproduction/Legends|bore]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]].<ref name="TEGTC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> In [[45 ABY]],<ref name="GH-Date">The table of contents for ''[[Star Wars Insider 142]]'' states that the "[[Good Hunting]]" leads into the events of [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]. ''Crucible'' dates itself to 45 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after {{Film|IV}}. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the end of ''A New Hope'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], thus ''Crucible'' and "Good Hunting" must take place in [[45 ABY]].</ref> during a vacation on the planet [[Luuhar]], Tenel Ka's pet [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] ran off. Upon running after the [[Feline/Legends|feline]], Tenel Ka [[Force sense/Legends|sensed danger]] and yelled a Dathomiri war cry upon drawing [[Tenel Ka Djo's lightsaber|her]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="GH">{{InsiderCite|142|Good Hunting}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ilm-ewok2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Dathomiri first appeared in ''Ewoks: The Battle for Endor'' (pictured).]]
The Dathomirian language first appeared, albeit through [[retroactive continuity]], in the [[1985]] direct-to-video movie, ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''.<ref name="BFE" /> After Charal was retconned to have been a member of the Nightsisters in the [[1995]] book, ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'',<ref name="Illustrated" /> the cultural language she incanted was thus also retconned to one of the Witches of Dathomiri.<ref name="BFE" /> Prior to this retcon, the language made its first proper appearance in the [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', written by [[Dave Wolverton]].<ref name="COPL" /> It was first identified as Dathomiri in "[[Good Hunting]]," a short story released in the [[Star Wars Insider 142|one hundred fourty-second]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine series<ref name="GH" /> on [[June 10]], [[2013]].<ref name="InsideScoop">{{SWArchive|url=news/get-the-inside-scoop-on-star-wars-insider-142.html|text=Get the Inside Scoop on Star Wars Insider #142}}</ref>

Several sources erroneously state that the Witches of Dathomir spoke Paecian.<ref name="TDS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> However, ''The Courtship of Princess Leia'', from which these claims are taken, states in actuality that the language the Dathomirians speak is a different, but similar language.<ref name="COPL" />
